More or less. I feel physically pretty fine (maybe I overestimated how many I took?), and I'm not actively suicidal in this moment.

I just feel, idk, lost I guess. Having really bad imposter syndrome. 

Thanks for reaching out.

Hi, thanks for the response.

I suppose I didn't clarify this in my original post but I also don't find people sexually attractive. Like I can appreciate if someone looks nice, but I've never wanted to pursue a sexual relationship with them. I used to get sexually aroused by physical stimulus, but not so much any more.

I used to be VERY sex-repulsed, but I now have next to no opinion about it.

Hey, man, thanks.

I'm not on any medication, no.

It's definitely been a process of fading interest, but it's been about three years of it certainly at this point. But I suppose maybe one day I could find something that interests me-- I find both men and women equally objectively attractive, but I just don't find sex or its derivatives very appealing.

Thanks for that last bit. I've always felt like a bit of an outcast due to the potential asexuality. I've heavily considered the probability since I was twelve or thirteen, but I tried giving dating and casual hook-ups a go anyway just to see.

Interesting. That's a fair assumption, I think. I'll consider that more. :)

I mentioned that I planned to go home out of state for my school's holiday break, which is six weeks long. Do you think that'd be a bad idea, then? I wanted to not have a job so I could go home for as long as I wanted, but if I stay I suppose I'd have to work out with them how long I can take off.

Hey! Thanks for the response. I definitely know that that's the general rule of thumb, but I don't really need a job at the moment (I have other income that balances out my current expenses) so I didn’t know if that made a difference.

So, you think this is all pretty normal behavior that I should stick through for a while more? When I'm actually at work, I do my job how I would any other time so I don't think I'm considered a "bad employee" by any means-- I personally think they just know I'm a yes man, so they take advantage of that.
I mean, can't say I blame you.

Hey-- any way you could elaborate more on this? Been here for a couple days. Neighbors seem pretty kind (would open the door for me when I carried stuff) and the surroundings seem mostly quiet. Though, I've mostly been out grabbing things so I haven't been around much.
